## Get orthologous genes 
```{r}
pannagram_1_1_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/coordinates_without_genes.csv", header=T, sep=",")
colnames(pannagram_1_1_genes) <- c("thaliana_id", "lyrata_start", "lyrata_end","lyrata_chr")
## Intersect with thaliana ids
genes_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")  %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_athaliana$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", genes_athaliana$V9)
genes_athaliana[, gene_id_clean := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
genes_athaliana <- genes_athaliana %>% dplyr::select(V1,V4,V5,gene_id_clean)
colnames(genes_athaliana) <- c("chr_thal", "star_thal", "end_thal", "gene_id_thal")
## Connect coordinates to genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- inner_join(pannagram_1_1_genes,genes_athaliana, by=c("thaliana_id"="gene_id_thal"))
```

## Dotplot thaliana-lyrata 
```{r}
# Change crhomosome names
pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr <- case_when(
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000001.1" ~ "Chr1",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000112.1" ~ "Chr2",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000223.1" ~ "Chr3",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000334.1" ~ "Chr4",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000445.1" ~ "Chr5",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000556.1" ~ "Chr6",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000667.1" ~ "Chr7",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000762.1" ~ "Chr8",
  TRUE ~ pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr)

## Get the chromosome length 
thal_lengths <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  group_by(chr_thal) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_pos = max(end_thal)) %>%
  arrange(chr_thal) %>%
  mutate(cum_start = lag(cumsum(max_pos), default = 0))

# Chromosome lengths and cumulative positions for A. lyrata
lyr_lengths <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  group_by(lyrata_chr) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_pos = max(lyrata_end)) %>%
  arrange(lyrata_chr) %>%
  mutate(cum_start = lag(cumsum(max_pos), default = 0))

# Add cumulative positions to the main df
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  left_join(thal_lengths %>% dplyr::select(chr_thal, cum_start), by = "chr_thal") %>%
  dplyr::rename(cum_start_thal = cum_start) %>%
  left_join(lyr_lengths %>% dplyr::select(lyrata_chr, cum_start), by = "lyrata_chr") %>%
  dplyr::rename(cum_start_lyr = cum_start) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cum_pos_thal = cum_start_thal + (star_thal + end_thal) / 2,
    cum_pos_lyr = cum_start_lyr + (lyrata_start + lyrata_end) / 2
  )

# Detect transposed genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  mutate(
    nn_dist = kNNdist(cbind(cum_pos_thal, cum_pos_lyr), k = 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(chr_thal, lyrata_chr) %>%
  mutate(n_in_group = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(is_isolated = nn_dist > 1e6)

# Mark fridgida gene

p <- ggplot(pannagram_1_1_genes, aes(x = cum_pos_thal / 1e6, y = cum_pos_lyr / 1e6)) +
  geom_point(color = "#1E104E", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, is_isolated),
             shape = 21, size = 1, fill = "#1E104E", color = "#1E104E", stroke = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
  #geom_point(data = filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, gene_id_thal == "AT4G00650"),
         #    shape = 21, size = 3, fill = "#FF653F", color = "#1E104E", stroke = 1) +
  labs(x = "A. thaliana cumulative position (Mbp)", y = "A. lyrata cumulative position (Mbp)") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)
p
ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/transposed_genes.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 150, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
## Flanking genes analysis 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
window_bp <- 1000000      # 1 Mb neighbourhood in both species
max_neighbours <- 2    # retain only points with <= 2 nearby plotted genes
# Positions for every gene in the dot plot
reference_positions <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  transmute(
    ref_id = thaliana_id,
    chr_thal,
    lyrata_chr,
    ref_x = cum_pos_thal,
    ref_y = cum_pos_lyr
  )

# Positions for your existing neighbourhood-disruption candidates
candidate_positions <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  transmute(
    focal_id = thaliana_id,
    chr_thal,
    lyrata_chr,
    focal_x = cum_pos_thal,
    focal_y = cum_pos_lyr
  )

# Count other genes close in BOTH x and y coordinates.
# Genes in a diagonal block will have many close local points.
candidate_2d_density <- candidate_positions %>%
  inner_join(
    reference_positions,
    by = c("chr_thal", "lyrata_chr")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    focal_id != ref_id,
    abs(focal_x - ref_x) <= window_bp,
    abs(focal_y - ref_y) <= window_bp
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(focal_id, name = "n_local_2d_neighbours")

# Keep candidate genes that are spatially isolated in the dot plot
neighbourhood_candidates_filtered <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  left_join(
    candidate_2d_density,
    by = c("thaliana_id" = "focal_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_local_2d_neighbours = coalesce(n_local_2d_neighbours, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_local_2d_neighbours <= max_neighbours)

moved_genes <- ggplot(
  pannagram_1_1_genes,
  aes(x = cum_pos_thal / 1e6, y = cum_pos_lyr / 1e6)
) +
  geom_point(color = "#053061", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = neighbourhood_candidates_filtered,
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = "#d6604d",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(pannagram_1_1_genes, thaliana_id == "AT4G00650"),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    fill = "#238443",
    color = "#1E104E",
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "A. thaliana cumulative position (Mbp)",
    y = "A. lyrata cumulative position (Mbp)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/transposed_genes.png",
       plot = moved_genes,
       width = 130, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Check presence of introns 
```{r}
# Load gff of athaliana 
athaliana_gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")
ath_genes_gff <- athaliana_gff[V3 == "CDS",]
ath_genes_gff[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", V9)]
## Map to the genes 
single_moved_genes_mapped <- inner_join(neighbourhood_candidates_filtered,ath_genes_gff, by=c("thaliana_id"="gene_id"))
## Check presene of introns
# Extract exons for moved genes only
ath_exons <- athaliana_gff[V3 == "exon"]
ath_exons[, gene_id := sub(".*Parent=([^.]+).*", "\\1", V9)]
# Count exons per gene introns = exons - 1
gene_structure <- ath_exons[gene_id %in% neighbourhood_candidates_filtered$thaliana_id,
                             .(n_exons = .N), by = gene_id]
gene_structure[, n_introns := n_exons - 1]
gene_structure[, has_intron := n_introns >= 1]
genes_with_introns_lyrata_thaliana <- gene_structure[gene_structure$has_intron=="TRUE",]
```

## Gene moves visualization
```{r}
## Make circulat plot
# Only between-chromosome gene movements
library(data.table)
library(circlize)

setDT(moved_genes)

to_chr <- function(x) paste0("Chr", sub("^Chr", "", as.character(x)))

thaliana_levels <- paste0("Chr", 1:5)
lyrata_levels   <- paste0("Chr", 1:8)

# ---- keep only inter-chromosomal moves ----
moves <- moved_genes[
  to_chr(chr_thal) != to_chr(lyrata_chr),
  .(gene_id,
    chr_thal   = factor(to_chr(chr_thal),   levels = thaliana_levels),
    lyrata_chr = factor(to_chr(lyrata_chr), levels = lyrata_levels))
]

# ---- count unique genes: source (lyrata) -> destination (thaliana) ----
movement_counts <- moves[
  , .(n_genes = uniqueN(gene_id)),
  by = .(lyrata_chr, chr_thal)
]

# Matrix rows = source (lyrata), cols = destination (thaliana)
movement_matrix <- as.matrix(
  dcast(
    movement_counts,
    lyrata_chr ~ chr_thal,
    value.var = "n_genes",
    fill = 0,
    drop = FALSE
  )[, -1]
)

rownames(movement_matrix) <- paste0("A.lyr_", lyrata_levels)
colnames(movement_matrix) <- paste0("A.thal_", thaliana_levels)

# ---- colors ----
shared_colors_base <- c(
  "Chr1" = "#b35806", "Chr2" = "#e08214", "Chr3" = "#f1b6da", "Chr4" = "#542788",
  "Chr5" = "#4d9221", "Chr6" = "#d73027", "Chr7" = "#fee090", "Chr8" = "#80cdc1"
)

lyrata_colors <- setNames(shared_colors_base[lyrata_levels],   paste0("A.lyr_", lyrata_levels))
thal_colors   <- setNames(shared_colors_base[thaliana_levels], paste0("A.thal_", thaliana_levels))
grid_col      <- c(lyrata_colors, thal_colors)

link_col <- matrix(
  lyrata_colors[rownames(movement_matrix)],
  nrow = nrow(movement_matrix),
  ncol = ncol(movement_matrix),
  dimnames = dimnames(movement_matrix)
)

# Plot
png(
  filename = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/circle_diagram.png",
  width = 200, height = 100, units = "mm", res = 600, type = "cairo", bg = "white"
)
circos.clear()
chordDiagram(
  x = movement_matrix,
  grid.col = grid_col,
  col = link_col,
  directional = 1,
  direction.type = c("arrows", "diffHeight"),
  link.arr.length = 0.1,
  link.arr.width  = 0.08,
  link.visible = movement_matrix > 0,
  transparency = 0.35,
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.08),
  link.border = NA
)

circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, bg.border = NA, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  s <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
  lab <- sub(".*Chr", "", s)
  xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
  ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
  circos.text(mean(xlim), ylim[1] + 0.1, lab,
              facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
              adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.55)
})

dev.off()
```

## Define compartments in lyrata and thaliana 
```{r}
pi_4fold_thal <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_diversity_thaliana/4fol_sites_thal_27g_tair10_based_pi.txt", header=TRUE, sep='\t') %>% na.omit() %>% distinct()
##Read Pi in lyrata 
pi4_fold_lyrata <-  read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_divergence_diversity_thal_lyr/4fol_sites_lyr_31g_tair10_based_pi.txt", header=T, sep='\t')
pi4_fold_lyrata <- pi4_fold_lyrata[pi4_fold_lyrata$pop=="LYR",] %>% na.omit()
```

```{r}
## Calculate pi in windows 
calc_window <- function(data, window_size = 500000, step_size = window_size) {
  chromosomes <- unique(data$chromosome)
  results <- list()
  for (chr in chromosomes) {
    chr_data <- data %>% 
      filter(chromosome == chr)
    max_pos <- max(chr_data$window_pos_2, na.rm = TRUE)
    starts <- seq(1, max_pos, by = step_size)
    for (ws in starts) {
      we <- ws + window_size - 1
      overlap <- chr_data %>% 
        filter(window_pos_1 <= we & window_pos_2 >= ws)
      if (nrow(overlap) == 0) next
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- overlap %>%
        mutate(
          window_start = ws,
          window_end = we
        )
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

# Calculate average pi/dxy
average_pi <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      avg_pi_window = sum(count_diffs) / sum(count_comparisons),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

pi_4fold_thal <- pi_4fold_thal %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()
pi4_fold_lyrata <- pi4_fold_lyrata %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()
## Add median pi for each chromosome
## Define high and low windows 
pi_4fold_thal <- pi_4fold_thal %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(median_pi = median(avg_pi_window))
pi4_fold_lyrata <- pi4_fold_lyrata %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(median_pi = median(avg_pi_window))
## Define high low compartments
pi_4fold_thal$compartment <- ifelse(pi_4fold_thal$avg_pi_window>pi_4fold_thal$median_pi, "high", "low")
pi4_fold_lyrata$compartment <- ifelse(pi4_fold_lyrata$avg_pi_window>pi4_fold_lyrata$median_pi, "high", "low")
# Join tables and define movements 
pi_both_species <- inner_join(pi_4fold_thal,pi4_fold_lyrata, by=c("chromosome", "window_start"), suffix=c("_thal", "_lyrata"))
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
# Convert to data.table
genes_dt <- as.data.table(moved_genes)
pi_dt    <- as.data.table(pi_both_species)

# Create interval columns with distinct names for the overlap join
genes_interval <- genes_dt[, .(
  gene_id,
  gene_chr   = chr_thal,
  gene_start = star_thal,
  gene_end   = end_thal
)]

windows_interval <- pi_dt[, .(
  chromosome,
  window_start,
  window_end_thal,
  window_end_lyrata,
  avg_pi_window_thal,
  median_pi_thal,
  compartment_thal,
  avg_pi_window_lyrata,
  median_pi_lyrata,
  compartment_lyrata
)]

# foverlaps needs interval keys
setkey(windows_interval, chromosome, window_start, window_end_thal)
setkey(genes_interval, gene_chr, gene_start, gene_end)

# Keep all windows that overlap a gene
gene_windows <- foverlaps(
  x = genes_interval,
  y = windows_interval,
  by.x = c("gene_chr", "gene_start", "gene_end"),
  by.y = c("chromosome", "window_start", "window_end_thal"),
  type = "any",
  nomatch = 0L
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Count genes/windows in each thaliana × lyrata compartment combination

  ) +
```

# Chi square test
```{r}
library(data.table)

# Assuming moved_genes contains the same compartment columns
dat <- copy(gene_windows)

# Ensure consistent ordering
dat[, compartment_thal := factor(compartment_thal, levels = c("low", "high"))]
dat[, compartment_lyrata := factor(compartment_lyrata, levels = c("low", "high"))]

# Counts for low-low, low-high, high-low, high-high
tab <- table(
  Source = dat$compartment_thal,
  Destination = dat$compartment_lyrata
)

tab
# Test of independance
chisq_out <- chisq.test(tab)
chisq_out
chisq_out$expected
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Your existing 2x2 contingency table:
# tab <- table(
#   Source = moved_genes$compartment_thal,
#   Destination = moved_genes$compartment_lyrata
# )

# Chi-square test
chi_out <- chisq.test(tab)

# Convert observed and expected values to a plotting data frame
plot_dat <- as.data.table(as.table(tab))
setnames(plot_dat, "N", "observed")

expected_dat <- as.data.table(as.table(chi_out$expected))
setnames(expected_dat, "N", "expected")

plot_dat <- merge(
  plot_dat,
  expected_dat,
  by = c("Source", "Destination")
)

# Create transition names and classify outcomes
plot_dat[, transition := paste(Source, "→", Destination)]
plot_dat[, movement_class := fifelse(
  Source == Destination,
  "Same compartment",
  "Different compartment"
)]

# Keep a biologically intuitive order
plot_dat[, transition := factor(
  transition,
  levels = c("low → low", "low → high", "high → low", "high → high")
)]

# Long format: one bar for observed and one for expected
plot_long <- melt(
  plot_dat,
  id.vars = c("Source", "Destination", "transition", "movement_class"),
  measure.vars = c("observed", "expected"),
  variable.name = "count_type",
  value.name = "count"
)

# Plot
ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = transition, y = count, fill = count_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(observed = "#238441", expected = "#053061")) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = paste0("χ² = ", round(chi_out$statistic, 2),
                       ", df = ", chi_out$parameter,
                       ", p = ", format.pval(chi_out$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)),
    x = NULL, y = "Gene count", fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18)
```
